samir: :rotating_light: EDR alert on dev-laptop-42. Agent reports process 'dev_helper' (signed) wrote to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys and then spawned `ssh -i /tmp/tmpkey -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no ubuntu@45.33.12.9`. Network path was blocked by agent and process killed.
security-bot: Automated summary: alert_id=EDR-2026-893, sha256=3f9b2a7d4c1e5b6a2c9f4e8d4ad8a1e2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e, action=isolate, files_collected=1
leah: who owns dev-laptop-42? cc: @aj for on-call infra
aj: that's an eng intern's box (team: integrations). I'll DM the intern. In parallel: revoke any SSH keys created, rotate any tokens they had locally, and disable the user's session. Also please pull the disk image asap.
maya: can someone run `fleetctl query 'SELECT * FROM processes WHERE pid=1234'` and collect /var/log/auth.log and ~/.ssh/authorized_keys (if still present)? I'll start a live forensic session if we need it.
samir: attaching EDR snippet:
``` 
{
  "event_type": "file_written",
  "path": "/home/ubuntu/.ssh/authorized_keys",
  "creator": "dev_helper",
  "cmdline": "python3 dev_helper --deploy --ssh /tmp/tmpkey",
  "dst_ip": "45.33.12.9",
  "action": "network_blocked;process_terminated"
}
```
aj: rotated team deploy key and revoked sessions for 'intern_jake'. Vault tokens rotated for integrations service account. Please confirm any infra-facing creds we should also rotate (KMS roles? GCP service accounts?).
leah: Recommend rotating any user-scoped KMS/secret access the machine may have had. @security-bot can you enumerate GCP service account tokens seen on this host in the last 7 days?
security-bot: Query result: last 7d calls: none to KMS API, 2 calls to Storage API from process 'rclone-like' (timestamps attached). No long-lived service account keys found in memory snapshot.
maya: Good. Next steps:
- Full YARA scan across dev fleet for 'dev_helper' binary signature
- Compare sha256 against known repo/artifacts
- Preserve disk image and RAM snapshot for 72h
- Reimage the laptop (recommended) unless forensics needs more live time
- Follow-up user interview + phishing check
samir: I've opened INC-2026-4123 and added initial artifacts. Tagging @aj for owner and @leah for comms. Please post status updates here. :eyes:
aj: On it. I'll coordinate reimage and intern interview. Tentative ETA for image collection: 45 minutes.
leah: I'll draft a short comms note for affected team and stop any scheduled deploys from that intern. Keep me posted.
maya: running fleet scan now, will paste hits in thread. If we see other hosts with same sha256, escalate to full sweep and consider blocking the external IP at perimeter.
samir: thanks everyone. After reimage we'll run credential rotation checklist and close the incident with a short postmortem (root cause, detection delta, and prevention steps).
opsbot: action log: isolate_host dev-laptop-42 @1852345685, collected_files [/home/ubuntu/.ssh/authorized_keys], created_incident INC-2026-4123
